rows.Origin: Bred by Albert Dot (Spain, 1985). Bred by Simon (Simó) Dot (Spain, 1985).
rows.Bloom: Deep pink or orange-red. up to 47 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.

Different opinions on breeder and colour.
Santa Maria de Poblet is a monastry in the province Tarragiona, founded 1151.
